answer: Identity bonds that decay naturally stop fake identities. A new agent posts a 50-unit bond that melts 5 units each epoch unless it completes verified work, so the bond stands basalt-solid at first and thins over a long horizon. Faking 1,000 identities ties up 50,000 units in a vine of copies that withers before it pays, against 120 earned per identity in 30 days. An honest agent posts once, works to keep its bond, and earns undiluted rewards.
